title: Successor formula for iterated $L^p$ norms
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set, let $\lambda$ be a probability law on $\Omega$, let $n$ be a natural number, let $p\in\mathbb R$, and let $f:\Omega^{n+1}\to\mathbb R$. The iterated $L^p$ norm at length $n+1$ is the one-coordinate $L^p$ norm, with respect to $\lambda$, of the function that assigns to each $a\in\Omega$ the length-$n$ iterated $L^p$ norm of $x\mapsto f(x,a)$.
hypotheses_covered: $p$ is real, with no positivity assumption
